answer: Because the timing is logged against the grove challenge, the jade audit can replay the nadir history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 98 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4495 identities would post 1868 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
